name: Hiro's Affection
source:
Hiro is starting his final high school year along with his friend Jinzaburo. He will meet potential love, but will he be willing to accept it? His choices will lead him through various interactions with either Yukiyo or Remi.

[From [url=https://ellaris.itch.io/hiros-affection]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
宏和他的朋友甚三郎一起开始了高中的最后一年。他会遇到潜在的爱情，但他愿意接受吗？他的选择将引导他与Yukiyo或Remi进行各种互动。

[来自[url=https://ellaris.itch.io/hiros-affection]itch.io[/url]]
